items.h: Rhode Island's 2026 Christmas Season Events Guide
items.sum: Dates, times and prices for Trinity Rep, Cirque du Soleil, the Boston Pops, The Nutcracker, the Newport mansions, tree lightings and light displays statewide.

items.h: Ringing in 2027: Rhode Island's New Year's Eve guide
items.sum: Family skate parties, tasting dinners, black-tie balls, live bands and comedy across the state on Thursday, Dec. 31.

items.h: Rhode Island Today and Tonight: Gatsby, Almost, Maine and Storytime
items.sum: Tonight's best picks are The Great Gatsby at 7:30 p.m. at PPAC and Almost, Maine at 7:30 p.m. in West Warwick, with family options from storytime to a LEGO club.

items.h: Rhode Island Comic Con takes over Providence, Nov. 6–8
items.sum: Three days of pop culture at the Rhode Island Convention Center and Amica Mutual Pavilion.

items.h: The Great Gatsby Musical Roars Into PPAC, Nov. 3–8
items.sum: The Tony-winning Broadway musical brings the Roaring Twenties to downtown Providence for eight performances.

items.h: Newport County holiday-assistance registration is open
items.sum: The MLK Community Center is accepting in-person applications for holiday food and children’s gifts; Thanksgiving registration ends November 13.

items.h: Newport Classical's holiday concerts bring choral music to December
items.sum: Christmas with Cantus, Messiah at the Mansion and Frisson play Dec. 5, 6 and 12.

items.h: Chorus of Westerly Rings In the Season With Vaughan Williams' Hodie
items.sum: Saturday, November 14 at 6 p.m. and Sunday, November 15 at 3 p.m. at George Kent Performance Hall in Westerly.

items.h: Ballet RI's In Motion Comes to Westerly's United Theatre, Nov. 6
items.sum: Friday, November 6 at 7:30 p.m. at the United Theatre in Westerly, with three works including a company premiere.

items.h: Providence Singers Sing American Voices in Warren and Providence
items.sum: Choral concerts Nov. 21 in Warren and Nov. 22 in Providence, with Copland, folk songs and a bluegrass Mass.

items.h: Holiday Premiere: Handmade Gifts at WaterFire Arts Center
items.sum: A day of local makers, coffee and food trucks, with no-charge admission on Sunday, Nov. 15.

items.h: Providence Winter Farmers Market Opens Its Season Saturday
items.sum: Local farm and food vendors open the winter market at 10 Sims Avenue on Saturday, Nov. 7.

items.h: Big Brothers Big Sisters of Rhode Island marks 60 years
items.sum: Its anniversary breakfast in Lincoln raised more than $100,000 for mentoring programs.

items.h: Almost, Maine Brings Northern Lights Romance to West Warwick
items.sum: The Arctic Playhouse stages John Cariani's comedy on evenings and Sunday afternoons through Nov. 22.

items.h: Newport Classical Adds a Piano Debut and Guitar to November
items.sum: Two Friday concerts at the Recital Hall, Nov. 6 and Nov. 20, bring a new pianist and Spanish and Latin guitar music.

items.h: Blithewold's Expressions of Nature Reception Set for Nov. 15
items.sum: Family programs on Nov. 7 and a gallery reception on Nov. 15 fill a busy fall stretch at the Bristol estate.
